exclusion_detail: Lead Ph-HTBA (1i) is made from benzaldehyde 2i by Wittig (GP B), hydrogenation (GP C), PPA cyclization (GP D), Claisen-Schmidt with glyoxylic acid (GP G) and Luche reduction (GP A): 5 reactions. The alternative via 5b + Suzuki is longer.

lead.label: 1i (Ph-HTBA)
lead.why: Abstract: 'we present Ph-HTBA (1i) with enhanced mid-nanomolar affinity for the CaMKIIalpha binding site'

notes: Every analog 1a-n goes through the same 5-reaction core sequence (Wittig, hydrogenation, cyclization, condensation, Luche) or longer (cross-couplings), so no other compound qualifies. Step count 5 read from Scheme 1 text and General Procedures A-G; 2i's procedure sources were not checked further.
